dialogue.instruction: Chatea con el aldeano y elige la respuesta correcta en cada turno. Tema: comparaciones.

turns.npc: Hi! Look at my two pickaxes. Which one is better?

options.text: The diamond pickaxe is better than the wood one.
The diamond pickaxe is more good than the wood one.
The diamond pickaxe is better the wood one.

turns.npc: Yes! Now look at these mountains. What can you say?

options.text: That mountain is taller than this hill.
That mountain is more tall than this hill.
That mountain is taller that this hill.

turns.npc: Good job! And what about the creeper and the zombie?

options.text: The creeper is more dangerous than the zombie.
The creeper is dangerouser than the zombie.
The creeper is more dangerous then the zombie.

turns.npc: Wow, you are smart! Which house is the best in the village?

options.text: My house is the biggest in the village.
My house is the most big in the village.
My house is the bigger in the village.
